name: Zillions generated sound effects pack
notes: Short sound effects for UI, weapons, aliens, zombies, robots, and town/colony actions.
28 effects were generated through Venice; mine_collapse uses a local synthetic fallback because the final Venice retrieve failed after generation.
These are concept assets and are not wired into runtime playback yet.
No API keys or source secrets are stored in this repository.

sounds.prompt: Alien acid spit projectile, wet pressure launch, sizzling corrosive impact, short creature attack sound.
Alien brood screech, insectoid and wet, aggressive warning cry, game-ready creature vocalization.
Alien psychic pulse attack, low brain-rattling hum, warped chime, pressure wave, sci-fi horror RTS.
Toxic spore cloud release, organic sac burst, hiss, floating particles, unsettling alien ambience.
Heavy mech laser cannon, charging tone then thick energy beam zap, short RTS weapon sound.
Robot unit death, sparks, servo collapse, short electric failure sound.
Robot squad servo march, synchronized metal feet, hydraulic whirs, mechanical army movement loop.
Sci-fi shield overload, rising electric strain then pop and crackle, clean game effect.
RTS building construction, hammering wood and metal, small generator tools, frontier colony work sound.
Wind generator power hum, low electrical thrum, rotating machinery, loopable colony ambience.
Quarry or mine collapse, rocks cracking, dust burst, workers shouting far away, short RTS alert sound.
Frontier town bell alarm, urgent iron bell, distant frightened crowd, grim survival colony.
Hero level up sting, Warcraft 3 inspired, holy relic shimmer, brass hit, magical chimes, triumphant short game cue.
Hero revive sound, sci-fi drop pod ignition mixed with magical resurrection shimmer, short powerful game cue.
Incoming horde alarm for grim colony RTS, distant siren, warning klaxon, low drums, urgent but not too loud.
Dark sci-fi RTS UI click, short metallic tick with subtle holographic chirp, clean game interface sound.
Warcraft style command denied sound, short low error buzz, grim sci-fi interface, not musical.
RTS minimap waypoint ping, bright arcane sci-fi blip with tiny echo, clean and readable.
Heavy space marine bolter burst, three chunky explosive rifle shots, shell clacks, grimdark battlefield.
Chainsword rev and swing, brutal motorized blade, metal bite, short melee attack sound for grimdark RTS.
Short flamethrower burst, pressurized fuel ignition, roaring flame, scorched zombie battlefield.
RTS grenade explosion, dirt and metal debris, compact battlefield blast, no long cinematic tail.
Squad lasgun volley, thin red energy rifle shots in rapid sequence, StarCraft style sci-fi infantry fire.
Plasma rifle charge and release, rising electric whine, hot blue energy blast, heavy sci-fi weapon impact.
Futuristic sniper railgun shot, sharp crack, electromagnetic snap, distant echo, powerful but clean.
Huge undead brute roar, wet chest resonance, angry monster bellow, short boss enemy sound.
Wet zombie melee hit, flesh impact against armor, short crunchy combat sound.
Building infection burst, wet plague pop, many small undead whispers, colony horror RTS sound.
Large zombie horde groan, layered undead voices, distant but threatening, loopable RTS ambience.
